topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a parchment, its edges frayed, tucked under the weight of stones where we often rest. My paws trembled as they flipped through, each line a pulse of the unknown. The words danced in a code, yet their shadow loomed heavy. Mountains too high to climb, oceans too vast to cross, names of places I could scarcely imagine. How many suns will wane before these dreams are dust? I can't shake the restlessness, a breeze that won't settle, urging me to chase the horizon or hide in the familiar. Each step now feels weighted, the air thick with an unspoken promise and the specter of time.
